darwin.notes: macOS 1.2.5: sample rows now show file details in a table; improved playback and preview of longer audio; Click to Play and tempo-preserving PITCH with typing, drag, trackpad scrolling and double-click reset. Restored pinch zoom and overview for long files marked LIMIT. Restored LOOP/ONESHOT classification and improved filename BPM in existing libraries so metadata filters include corrected results.

win32.notes: Windows 1.2.5: PITCH resets to +0.00 with a double-click anywhere on the control. Typed values accept only digits from 0 to 12 semitones.
